row.title: KGRAPH-1: every system keeps a knowledge graph
row.body: Each system serves a kg/1 graph built from its own data with provenance, bitemporal upkeep and shared model-free analytics; the tick step kgraph files KG-<id> until it is healthy; foundation kgraph --check fails a system with no row in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json.
